remarks: Charming and beautifully renovated home tucked away in a private setting, perfect for relaxing or entertaining! This move-in-ready gem features hardwood floors, a stylish and functional layout, and the convenience of garage parking. A great alternative to condo living without the shared walls! Ideally located just minutes to the train, shopping, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway for an easy commute. A rare find that blends comfort, privacy, and convenience!
